locations.name: The Mud Gate
locations.description: The busiest of the city's seven gates, choked with carts, beggars, and the reek of the river. Gold cloaks lean on their spears and watch the crowds with practised boredom.

locations.name: The Street of Steel
locations.description: Smoke and the ring of hammers fill the climbing street, where every armorer in the city keeps a forge. The higher you climb, the finer - and dearer - the steel.

locations.name: The Red Keep
locations.description: Pale red stone and seven drum-towers crown Aegon's High Hill. Beyond the throne room doors waits the Iron Throne itself, a mountain of blackened, beaten blades.

locations.name: Flea Bottom
locations.description: A warren of mud lanes and pot-shops where the smallfolk boil bowls o' brown and ask no questions. A dangerous place to be a stranger, and a fine place to be forgotten.

npcs.name: Captain Farring
npcs.title: Officer of the City Watch
npcs.description: A hard-eyed officer in a gold cloak, grown rich on the tolls and bribes that flow through his gate.

npcs.name: Wat the Smith
npcs.title: Master Armorer
npcs.description: A soot-stained master of the Street of Steel, whose plate is worn by knights who can afford the best.

npcs.name: Ser Willem Wode
npcs.title: Courtier of the Red Keep
npcs.description: A silk-clad hanger-on of the court, all perfume and smiling menace, who trades in whispers and favours.

npcs.name: Rue
npcs.title: A Little Bird
npcs.description: A ragged, sharp-eyed child of Flea Bottom who hears everything and sells it to whoever pays.

locations.name: The Lion's Mouth
locations.description: The great gate of Casterly Rock is a tunnel wide enough for horsemen to ride abreast, climbing up into the living mountain by torchlight and switchback stair.

locations.name: The Golden Gallery
locations.description: A long hall carved from the mountain's heart, its walls veined with gold and hung with the crimson banners of the lion. Even the sconces are worked in gold.

locations.name: The Gold Mines
locations.description: Deep beneath the Rock the mines run on forever, hot and close, where the wealth of the Westerlands is dug from the dark. The clink of picks never truly stops.

npcs.name: Ser Benedict Broom
npcs.title: Castellan of the Rock
npcs.description: A grey, precise knight who has kept the Rock for the lions through three lords, and forgotten more of its secrets than most men ever learn.

npcs.name: Ser Loras Vikary
npcs.title: Captain of the Guard
npcs.description: A broad, watchful knight in crimson and gold who judges every visitor by the coin and steel they carry.

npcs.name: Gerion Pyle
npcs.title: Master of the Mines
npcs.description: A blunt, calloused man who counts the Rock's true wealth by the wagonload and trusts no one near his ledgers.

locations.name: Sky
locations.description: The last of the three waycastles, where the mountain track gives out and the final six hundred feet to the Eyrie must be climbed by ladder and basket. The wind never stops screaming here.

locations.name: The High Hall
locations.description: A slender white hall of blue-veined marble, its floor patterned in the shape of falcon wings. In the middle of the floor is the Moon Door - a weirwood door that opens on six hundred feet of empty air.

locations.name: The Sky Cells
locations.description: Cells with only three walls, their floors sloping gently toward a lip of open sky. The cold and the drop do the gaolers' work, and prisoners beg to confess before they beg for food.

npcs.name: Lord Nestor Royce
npcs.title: High Steward of the Vale
npcs.description: A heavy, careful lord who has held the Gates and the Vale's keys for years, and knows precisely what his loyalty is worth.

npcs.name: Ser Albar Ruthermont
npcs.title: A Knight of the Vale
npcs.description: A proud winged knight who guards the ascent, courteous to the highborn and cold to all others.

npcs.name: Mad Osgood
npcs.title: Keeper of the Sky Cells
npcs.description: A grim gaoler who speaks of the Moon Door the way other men speak of the weather.

locations.name: The Great Curtain Wall
locations.description: A single wall a hundred feet high and forty thick on its seaward face, its stones so cunningly fitted the wind finds no purchase. No storm, siege, or sorcery has ever breached it.

locations.name: The Round Hall
locations.description: The great drum tower's hall, thick-walled and windowless against the storms, warmed by a hearth a man could stand in. The stag of the Baratheons broods above the high seat.

locations.name: Shipbreaker Bay
locations.description: Below the castle the cliffs fall to a shore littered with the bones of a thousand wrecked ships. The bay earns its name; few captains dare it, and fewer twice.

npcs.name: Ser Gawen Wylde
npcs.title: Castellan of Storm's End
npcs.description: A weathered knight who has held the great wall through wind and war, stubborn as the stones he keeps.

npcs.name: Maester Cressen
npcs.title: Maester of Storm's End
npcs.description: A gentle, aged maester whose chain and counsel have served the storm lords since before the rebellion.

npcs.name: Davos
npcs.title: Onion Trader
npcs.description: A low-born man of the sea with clever hands and an honest tongue, who knows every rock in Shipbreaker Bay.

locations.name: The Brier Gate
locations.description: A gate wreathed in climbing roses that never seem to wilt, opening on the fairest castle in the Reach. Even the guards wear green and gold, and smile as they bar your way.

locations.name: The Hall of Roses
locations.description: A bright, high hall where singers are never silent and the tables never quite empty. The golden rose of the Tyrells climbs every pillar; courtesy here is a weapon as keen as any sword.

locations.name: The Labyrinth Gardens
locations.description: Hedge mazes, briars, and fountains stretch for acres, thick with the hum of bees. Lovers and plotters alike lose themselves here, which is rather the point.

npcs.name: Ser Vortimer Crane
npcs.title: Steward of Highgarden
npcs.description: A smooth, silver-tongued steward who runs the Reach's richest household and misses nothing beneath his courtesies.

npcs.name: Ser Emmon Cuy
npcs.title: Knight of the Brier Gate
npcs.description: A flower of Reach chivalry, gracious and vain, forever polishing armor he hopes to wear at the next tourney.

npcs.name: Alaric of Eysen
npcs.title: A Wandering Singer
npcs.description: A travelled bard with a fine voice and a finer ear for the secrets great folk let slip when the wine flows.

locations.name: The Threefold Gate
locations.description: Three gates and three walls guard the way into Sunspear, opening on a blaze of sun-baked sandstone. Spearmen in orange and red watch you from the shade, unhurried.

locations.name: The Tower of the Sun
locations.description: A great domed hall of a thousand panes of colored glass, where the light falls in shafts of gold and blood. Here the Prince of Dorne sits his twin thrones, unbowed and unhurried.

locations.name: The Shadow City
locations.description: The winding mud-brick warren beneath Sunspear's walls, all shade and spice and whispered Rhoynish. A cool cup of wine and a knife in the dark are equally easy to find here.

npcs.name: Ricasso
npcs.title: Seneschal of Sunspear
npcs.description: The blind old seneschal of Sunspear, whose memory holds every debt, slight, and secret of Dorne.

npcs.name: Areo of Norvos
npcs.title: Captain of the Guard
npcs.description: A huge, silent guardsman with a longaxe, sworn to the Martells and utterly without fear.

npcs.name: Myria Sand
npcs.title: Spice Trader
npcs.description: A quick, dark-eyed trader of the shadow city who deals in spice, silk, and rarer things besides.
